protocol.name: RELATIVE_MOMENTUM_7D_LAST_WEEK_10X_100_V1
protocol.period_note: Seven completed daily01UTC-to01UTC cycles; freeze before collecting; current incomplete cycle excluded
protocol.ranking: Unchanged7-day return top/bottom20%, positive LONG/negative SHORT, historical previous24h turnover proxy>=5M, fixed26 current survivors
protocol.volatility_stop: Unchanged2*simpleATR14 daily known at decision; no TP; exit after24h or SL/liquidation
protocol.entry: Daily01UTC following00UTC decision, one-hour execution delay
protocol.sizing: Prior equal margin slots now multiplied by L to form desired notional, then jointly reduced so modeled stop risk<=2%equity and initial margin+two execution fees<=equity; current min/step/max lots
protocol.margin: Isolated per position, fixed leverage10, no automatic margin addition
protocol.liquidation: Threshold estimated from entry notional, current MMR tier and liquidation fee: entry*(1-sign/L+sign*(MMR+liq_fee)); historical fair-price H1 used to test crossing
protocol.liquidation_charge: Conservative loss of allocated initial isolated margin, entry fees and previously held funding; liquidation charges absorbed in forfeited margin, no double exit fee
protocol.ambiguity: If Fair liquidation and Last stop both touched in same H1, count liquidation first and flag ordering uncertain
protocol.funding: Historical signed settlements; debit available cash, no margin topups; assert cash available beyond locked margin sufficient; H1 marks
protocol.stop_validity: Report stops behind liquidation and 1.5x buffer violations as diagnostics; do not secretly move stops or exclude cases to improve results
protocol.control: Same100USD period at1x for paired interpretation, same risk cap and ranks; no parameter optimization
limitations: H1 execution and liquidation ordering cannot prove actual fills
